summary: Frontend-only testing for Phase 3A Pokémon Data Explorer completed successfully (backend skipped per request — already 54/54 pytest passing). All 18 acceptance criteria verified live against https://vgc-intelligence.preview.emergentagent.com with mobile viewport 390x844. Home shows 'DISPONIBLE' badge on the Pokédex quick-access tile; navigation to /pokemon works from both quick-access tile and menu-row-pokedex. Explorer loads first page with Bulbasaur (pager info 'Página 1 / 29 · 1417 resultados'); pager-prev correctly aria-disabled on page 1; pager-next advances to page 2. Search debounces and filters ('gholdengo' → Gholdengo row shown, 'zzzz' → pokemon-empty state, clear resets list). Type filter chips populate from /api/v1/types; filter-type-steel narrows list to 105 results (3 pages); filter-only-base toggle narrows to 1025 results. Detail screen for bulbasaur renders detail-name='Bulbasaur', detail-stats, detail-abilities with OCULTA badge (hidden ability Chlorophyll), and detail-moves-title='Movimientos (89)'. Not-found state (/pokemon/zzznotreal) correctly shows detail-not-found. Back navigation works detail → explorer → home. Language toggle switches Spanish↔English (e.g. 'DISPONIBLE'↔'LIVE', 'Datos canónicos de Pokémon Showdown.'↔'Canonical Pokémon Showdown data.'). No blocking issues. Minor console warning observed (non-blocking).

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Emitted on Home and detail screens. Likely coming from a third-party component (expo-linear-gradient / SafeAreaView / Ionicons wrapper). No functional impact — just a deprecation warning. Reference: browser console during navigation to /pokemon and /pokemon/zzznotreal.

action_items: (Optional / low priority) Investigate the source of 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' console warning — likely from a dependency and not from app code, so may not be actionable until upstream libs update.
critical_code_review_comments: apiGet in src/api/client.ts correctly guards against empty strings, encodes params, and surfaces ApiError with status — good for the 404 not-found flow in [id].tsx.
PokemonExplorer uses a monotonic requestSeq to drop stale responses on rapid search/filter changes — good race-condition handling for the 350ms debounce.

Detail screen fires 3 parallel apiGets in Promise.all — if any 404s (e.g. the base /pokemon/:id), the whole batch rejects and correctly maps to notFound. This is fine because abilities/moves endpoints only exist for valid pokemon, so the base 404 will always trip first.
All interactive elements have testID; text is wrapped in <Text>; StyleSheet.create used everywhere; SafeAreaView from react-native-safe-area-context (correct choice for edges='top').
seed_data_creation: None — canonical Showdown data already imported into sd_* collections (1417 base-only or 1517 total).
